name: Structural Compliance Checker
description: Check format spec adherence: heading hierarchy, section count, FAQ presence, word count per section, and total word count. Pure structural checks, no LLM needed.
usage_notes: Run after content-writer. Checks markdown structure against configurable thresholds. Pure text analysis -- no API calls. Check 8 (taxonomy_leak_check, default OFF => byte-identical to <=1.1.1) simulates the step-8 publish transform (markdown-output 1.2.0 removeMetaSection + shared marker-parser stripMarkers) and force-fails qa_pass if any residual bracket would leak to the reader -- the #50 defect (a second heading marker, a body-prose marker, or a trailing heading marker survives the single-leading-strip). It emits through the existing structural item => structural:fail, adding no new routing key; template v3 flips it on. LOCKSTEP: the strip simulation is mirrored VERBATIM from markdown-output/execute.js (stripMarkers :26-28, removeMetaSection :74-76); if those change, Check 8 MUST change with them or it stops matching the published page. Option is string-coercion tolerant: accepts boolean true and the string "true" (UI presets are string-typed); anything else, incl. "false", is off.

options.name: min_sections
options.label: Minimum sections
options.description: Minimum number of H2 sections required in the content.

options.name: require_faq
options.label: Require FAQ section
options.description: Fail if no FAQ or 'Frequently Asked Questions' section heading is found.

options.name: min_words_per_section
options.label: Min words per section
options.description: Minimum word count for each H2 section. Sections below this are flagged.

options.name: min_total_words
options.label: Min total words
options.description: Minimum total word count for the entire content.

options.name: required_heading_levels
options.label: Required heading levels
options.description: Comma-separated heading levels that must appear (e.g. 'h1,h2'). Content missing any of these levels fails.

options.name: pass_threshold
options.label: Pass threshold
options.description: Fraction of structural checks that must pass for qa_pass to be true. 1.0 means all checks must pass.

options.name: taxonomy_leak_check
options.label: Taxonomy-leak check (post-strip residual brackets)
options.description: Simulate the step-8 publish transform (markdown-output removeMetaSection + marker strip) and force-fail qa_pass if any bracket would still leak to the reader -- a second heading marker, a body-prose marker, or a trailing heading marker (the #50 defect). Citations [#n]/[n], footnote refs [^n], and markdown links [text](url) are excluded; code is skipped. Default off keeps output byte-identical to <=1.1.1.
